name: ambigo-platform
description: AmbiGo Smart Emergency Response & Traffic Coordination Platform (Driver + Officer)

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:driver" "npm run dev:officer"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=officer-frontend && npm run build --workspace=backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=frontend && npm run lint --workspace=backend
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --workspace=frontend && npm run type-check --workspace=officer-frontend && npm run type-check --workspace=backend
